Word to PDF

Convert a Word (.docx) file — or pasted text — into a clean, printable PDF. Text content is preserved; complex formatting is simplified.

Word to PDF

Convert a Word (.docx) file — or pasted text — into a clean PDF.

Please note: this converts the text content of your Word file into a PDF — complex formatting is simplified.

Only .docx files are supported (not old .doc). Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a .docx file — or paste text directly into the box instead.
  2. Click "Convert to PDF".
  3. The text is extracted and laid out as a clean PDF.
  4. The finished PDF downloads automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it keep my Word formatting?

Only the text content is carried over, rendered in a clean layout. Fonts, colors, tables and images from the original are simplified or dropped.

Why won't my old .doc file work?

Yes. The .docx format is a zip of XML files; older binary .doc files use a different format this tool cannot read. Save as .docx first.

Can I convert text without uploading a file?

You can. Leave the file picker empty and paste or type your text into the box instead, then convert.
